entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this jersey I bought. It's ridiculous. I've been trying to figure this out online and your website is useless.
I'm very sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Mike Peterson. Order number is VF887-21. And don't give me the runaround, I just want my money back.
Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Aero Race Jersey. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
What kind of question is that? It's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it or get a refund. This is taking forever, just get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate. I just need to confirm the details. So the fit is too tight and you'd like to return it. Let me just check the delivery date here...
You'd better. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make your heads spin. I know my rights as a consumer.
I appreciate your patience, Mike. Okay, I've reviewed your order and the good news is you are well within our 90-day return window for this jersey. I can absolutely process that for you right now.
Oh. Really? So you can just... do it?
Yes, absolutely. I can email you a prepaid return label immediately. Did you want to process a full refund, or would you prefer an exchange for a larger size?
An exchange would be good, actually. I like the jersey, it was just the wrong size. I guess I'll take a large.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for a size large and the return label is on its way to your email. Just pack the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out your new one.
Okay. That's... actually perfect. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mike. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
